assistworld-assist-world:lever:9a68e12d-.title: Senior Executive Assistant
assistworld-assist-world:lever:9a68e12d-.description: About the Role We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Senior Executive Assistant to support the principal of a private family office. This is a high-impact role that combines executive assistance, operations, research, project coordination, and personal assistance, requiring someone who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. The ideal candidate is exceptionally detail-oriented, highly responsive, and naturally curious, with the ability to anticipate needs before they arise. You'll serve as a trusted right hand, ensuring both business and personal priorities run seamlessly while allowing the principal to focus on strategic decision-making. This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, taking ownership, and finding creative solutions while managing a wide variety of responsibilities across both business and personal affairs. Key Responsibilities Executive Support ● Manage the principal's calendar, priorities, and daily workflow. ● Coordinate meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements. ● Monitor schedules and proactively remind the principal of upcoming commitments. ● Prepare meeting summaries, action items, and follow-up communications. ● Screen incoming requests and prioritize urgent matters. ● Act as the primary point of coordination for day-to-day executive support. Research & Decision Support ● Carry out due diligence and information gathering for business initiatives and investments. ● Solve problems independently by identifying the best available solutions. ● Conduct thorough research on vendors, products, services, and business opportunities. ● Source and compare suppliers, contractors, and specialist service providers. ● Present concise recommendations with pricing, timelines, pros and cons to enable informed decision-making. Family Office & Operational Support ● Provide operational support across the family office. ● Coordinate documentation, contracts, and administrative processes. ● Assist with opening financial and trading accounts, ensuring paperwork is completed accurately. ● Maintain organized records and confidential documentation. ● Support operational projects from planning through execution. Project Management ● Manage multiple projects simultaneously while keeping stakeholders informed. ● Coordinate with vendors, consultants, and external service providers. ● Track deadlines and ensure projects progress on schedule. ● Source highly specialized service providers when required. Personal Assistance ● Coordinate travel, dining reservations, appointments, and lifestyle requests. ● Research and secure difficult-to-obtain reservations, services, or experiences. ● Handle personal errands and administrative tasks with professionalism and discretion. ● Anticipate personal needs and proactively provide solutions. Market & Trading Support ● Monitor pre-defined market alerts and notify the principal immediately when action may be required. ● Follow established procedures regarding trading thresholds and priority notifications. ● Escalate urgent matters until they receive a response. ● Support administrative requirements related to investment activities. Ideal Candidate Profile We're looking for someone who is: ● Resourceful, independent, and naturally curious. ● An excellent researcher who enjoys solving problems. ● Calm under pressure with strong judgment. ● Patient, adaptable, and an exceptional listener. ● Comfortable supporting high-performing entrepreneurs and executives. ● Confident making recommendations without making assumptions. ● Tech-savvy and quick to learn new systems. ● Professional, discreet, and trustworthy with confidential information. ● Exceptionally organized with outstanding attention to detail. ● Highly proactive and able to anticipate needs before being asked. ● Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:dd.title: Transmission Engineering Manager
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:dd.description: We understand that finding the right place to work isn't easy. At Beta Engineering, we believe in cultivating a team that wins together and takes on the most challenging projects in the high-voltage industry. We engineer, procure, and construct (EPC) projects for a variety of customers, including those in the utility, industrial, and renewable energy markets. Our work includes substations, transmission lines and more. We help our customers achieve their goals of creating a stronger power grid by reducing risks and identifying innovative solutions for their project challenges. Our Purpose: We pursue that which challenges us, growing our community to provide critical, creative solutions that achieve extraordinary results. Our Values: We do what we say, we turn challenges into success and we win together. Beta Engineering is looking for a Transmission Engineering Manager to join our team anywhere in the United States. Transmission Engineering Managers (TEMs) are supervisors of multiple Transmission Engineer Team Leaders (TETL), Transmission Engineers (TE) and Transmission Engineering Technicians (TET) overseeing the design, interpretation, application and documentation of drawings, calculations, and designs. The TEM is tasked with ensuring that the Transmission Engineering Department’s designs, and applications, are completed to code and standards set forth by the appropriate authoritative bodies. In addition, TEMs are responsible for the training, recruiting, hiring, scheduling, assigning and discipline of TETLs, TEs and TETs under their supervision. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Responsible for all Transmission engineering design and activities Delegates engineering responsibilities and activities within the TE department Manages the design and checking processes of multiple teams Ensures training and development of TETLs, TEs and TETs Maintains design standards and training guidelines Resolves issues between design teams and departments Ensures technical questions posed by construction managers, field staff, project managers, customers and their representatives are addressed Recognizes and recommends methods to improve every customer’s experience Travels periodically to customer offices for project meetings, to job sites for construction visits and as necessary to perform managerial responsibilities with remote employees Performs bi-yearly evaluations on all employees reporting to them ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES: The Transmission Engineering Manager will have multiple employees reporting to this position. Coordinates the scheduling of employee PTO Recruits, hires and trains new engineers Provides input on organizational structure, employee performance, continuing education, employee development and disciplinary actions Enforces discipline policies within department Assures department and themselves adhere to and practice the Beta core competencies and Beta principles Additional duties as assigned by the Vice President of Engineering EXPECTATIONS: Performs quality work within deadlines without direct supervision. Interacts professionally with other employees and customers. Works effectively as a leader in the department. Demonstrates integrity and ethics in all client relationships and communications. Communicates regularly with supervisor and teams regarding designs, concerns, studies or tests Desires to participate in continued education and training Overnight travel to active job sites Must have clean driving record as use of company vehicles is a requirement of position EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Bachelor degree (or higher) in Civil, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering is required PE is required Previous design experience in overhead and underground transmission design including: grading, foundation design and details, PLS CADD design, plan and profiles, general arrangements, structure designs, steel details, sag tension and wire stringing. Previous supervisory experience is required Strong background in Microsoft

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:40d48a02-.title: Norton Partner Success Manager
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:40d48a02-.description: About Gen Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Partner Success Manager to drive the success of our Norton product portfolio by contributing directly to our partners’ business growth and achieving sales targets. This role requires someone who can deeply understand our security product strategy, proactively identify and engage partner companies with strong alignment to consumer security solutions—such as consumer electronics retailers and mobile phone agents—and translate that understanding into effective sales and partnership initiatives. As a Sales and Partnerships Manager, you will take ownership of partner relationships by going beyond transactional product sales to collaboratively plan and implement new services and sales expansion strategies. You will be expected to identify gaps in our current distribution network, develop new channels where we lack presence, and expand the reach of our security solutions. Additionally, you will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to align on growth strategies, ensuring that partnership initiatives contribute meaningfully to broader business objectives. About You - Experience in the PC or mobile industry - Experience working with consumer electronics retailers or mobile phone agencies - Experience in direct business development - Experience in the distribution or trading industries - Strong communication skills and negotiation capabilities - A proactive, self-starting mindset - Willingness to grow and take on challenges together with the company - Ability to work with a strong sense of responsibility and mission toward goals and expectations - Basic PC skills including document creation (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and email communication - Ambitious, responsible, and eager to take on a challenge Gen is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to fair, inclusive practices at every stage of the candidate and employee journey. Employment decisions are based on merit, experience and business needs.

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:09073822-797.description: About the Role We are looking for an Executive Assistant to act as a strategic right hand to our CEO. This is not a typical administrative position. Beyond handling calendar management and travel coordination in a fast-paced, chaotic environment, you will play an active role in research, analysis, and shaping the organization, as well as act as an "all round" aide to the CEO. We need a clear-thinking, proactive problem solver who can jump right in without needing hand-holding. You will analyze data, build reports, identify operational gaps, and bring solutions to the table before issues arise. Key Responsibilities 1. Executive Operations & Gatekeeping Act as the primary point of contact and buffer for the CEO, managing internal and external communications with tact and judgment. Maintain complete situational awareness of the CEO’s priorities, deadlines, and ongoing projects. Manage complex, fluid calendars across multiple time zones, adjusting dynamically to continuous travel schedule changes. Handle international travel arrangements, itineraries, paperwork, and logistics. 2. Data Analysis & Business Intelligence Gather data across departments to create clear, actionable executive reports, dashboards, and presentations. Continuously audit workflows and metrics to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and areas for process improvement. Conduct research and synthesize complex information into quick, digestible briefs for decision-making. Perform analysis using LLMs, spreadsheets, your own critical thinking & research. 3. Financial & Administrative Support Assist with financial tracking, expense management, budget auditing, and financial reporting. Monitor key financial indicators and track cross-departmental deliverables to ensure projects remain on budget and on schedule. Handle confidential business and financial information with high discretion. 4. Aide & Personal Support Making bookings, find service providers online and in person Requirements & Qualifications Turnkey Capability: Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Chief Of Staff, Business Operations Manager, or Strategic Coordinator. You can drop into a fast-moving environment on Day 1 without requiring extensive training. High IQ & Analytical Thinking: Exceptional logic and problem-solving ability. You don't just report data; you understand what the numbers mean and recommend action. Proactive & Autonomous: You anticipate needs before they are voiced and actively look for ways to lighten the CEO's operational load. Chaos Tolerance: High adaptability, mental resilience, and composure in fast-changing, high-pressure environments. Financial Literacy: Comfort with numbers, spreadsheets, financial statements, and basic business finance principles. Time Zone Agility: Willingness and technical setup to work evening/night shifts as needed. Some work may be required to be performed in the afternoon, some at night time. Tech Savvy: Advanced proficiency in modern workspace tools (e.g., Claude, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, Excel/Google Sheets, project management platforms). Language skills: Ability to speak English fluently, preferred knowledge of both Cantonese and Mandarin as well. Willingness to Travel: Certain work or tasks may be required to be performed physically in Hong Kong or Shenzhen on occasion. Yau are allowed to live and work anywhere in Hong Kong or Guangdong Province for this role.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2552b010-ee33-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Medical Director - Outpatient Medicare based in the United States. This is a senior clinical leadership role focused on utilization management and medical necessity decisions for Medicare populations. You will apply your clinical expertise and professional judgment to complex cases, balancing quality of care, regulatory requirements, and appropriate resource utilization. The role involves reviewing clinical documentation and claims while applying Medicare policies, national guidelines, and evidence-based standards. You will regularly collaborate with physicians, care management teams, and other healthcare professionals to resolve complex cases and support optimal outcomes. The position also provides opportunities to contribute to appeals, quality initiatives, population health, and broader healthcare transformation efforts. This fully remote role offers flexibility while connecting you with multidisciplinary teams and regional healthcare partners. It is an opportunity to combine clinical practice experience with healthcare strategy, analytics, and value-based care in a meaningful way. Review health claims, clinical documentation, and moderately complex to highly complex clinical cases using sound medical judgment and comprehensive analysis. Determine medical necessity and make authorization decisions regarding requested services, levels of care, and sites of service. Conduct computer-based utilization reviews, with cases primarily involving inpatient and post-acute care settings, while supporting outpatient services and equipment as applicable. Evaluate clinical records against national clinical guidelines, CMS policies and determinations, clinical reference materials, internal policies, and applicable contractual requirements. Apply Medicare and Medicare Advantage requirements consistently and translate regulatory and clinical knowledge into day-to-day utilization management decisions. Prioritize daily casework and communicate determinations clearly, accurately, and within required timeframes to internal stakeholders. Conduct peer-to-peer discussions with external physicians to obtain additional information, clarify clinical circumstances, and explain or discuss authorization decisions. Apply strong professional judgment and conflict-resolution skills when addressing disputed or complex clinical determinations. Provide clinical interpretation to assess whether services align with accepted standards of care, regulatory requirements, internal policies, and applicable contracts. Participate in grievance and appeals reviews and, where applicable, support oversight of coding, clinical documentation, outpatient services, and durable medical equipment. Collaborate with care managers, case managers, regional leaders, and cross-functional teams on complex cases, quality initiatives, and population health priorities. Build productive relationships with contracted physicians, medical groups, facilities, and community partners to support value-based care and regional healthcare initiatives. Requirements: MD or DO degree from an accredited medical institution. At least 5 years of direct clinical patient-care experience following residency or fellowship , preferably including inpatient experience and/or care of Medicare-eligible populations. Current and ongoing Board Certification in an ABMS-approved medical specialty . Current, unrestricted medical license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, with willingness to obtain additional licenses when required. Ability to meet credentialing requirements and maintain a record free of current federal or state governmental sanctions. pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:e681cf11-9b8a-463.description: FOUNDING ENGINEER, AI — SHIPLIGHT AI - Do you agree we’re living through the AI revolution? - Do you want to be part of it — and run ahead of the curve? - Are you ready to help 100x productivity? We believe every organization should have AI systems that can understand context, take action, and collaborate seamlessly with humans — transforming how work gets done across the enterprise. Our first mission: fully automate software quality assurance. We’re building state-of-the-art agentic QA systems that integrate deeply into the software development cycle — empowering every product manager, developer, and tester with their own AI QA engineer that validates work in real time. You’ll be joining a small, mission-driven founding team led by industry veterans, working at the intersection of AI agents, system engineering, and real-world developer productivity. IDEAL SKILLS - Strong engineering fundamentals and product mindset. - Proficiency in Python and TypeScript. - Deep understanding of context engineering and prompt-based reasoning systems. - Familiarity with browser automation, mobile automation, or QA tooling is a plus. - Comfortable working across the stack — backend, frontend, and AI interfaces. WHY JOIN NOW - Join at the earliest stage as the first founding engineer. - Shape both the product and technical vision. - Work directly with founders who’ve built successful systems and products before. - Receive generous equity and play a defining role in the company’s success.

Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move! The Specialty Alliance is a physician-led Management Services Organization (MSO) that supports leading specialty practices with national-scale infrastructure, data, and resources. Our partnership model preserves clinical autonomy while enabling responsible growth and high-quality specialty care nationwide. To learn more about The Specialty Alliance, visit www.thespecialtyalliance.com . todaytixgroup-todaytixgroup:lever:6e9068.description: About TodayTix Group: TodayTix Group (TTG) is the global e-commerce leader for cultural experiences, designing frictionless discovery and purchase journeys through innovative product design and industry-leading technology. Our portfolio of brands––including TodayTix, New York Theatre Guide, London Theatre, Show-Score, Arthouse, Arthouse London, and Secret Cinema––connects millions of customers with the best in live entertainment. Powered by vast data and insights, TTG helps theatres, producers, and cultural institutions reach highly engaged audiences and unlock meaningful revenue, transforming how tickets are sold across the world. In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI, the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement. Life at TodayTix Group We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next. New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development. Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work. We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply. About the Role: We're looking for a strategic, hands-on Director of CRM and Lifecycle Marketing to own our CRM program, every email, push, and SMS we send to millions of theatre and event-goers, and to lead the team that runs it. CRM is how we turn interest into action across a customer's life with us: getting new customers to their first show, keeping our best customers coming back, and winning back the ones who've drifted. You'll own that messaging end to end and be the person the company trusts on anything CRM. Our CRM already drives a large share of our business. Now we want to make it one of the smartest, most automated programs out there. We're building toward a Next Best Action model where automation and AI decide the right message, moment, and channel for each customer, at scale. We want someone genuinely energized by that: who sees automation and AI as the core of how a modern CRM program runs, and who will keep pushing what's possible, including piloting new channels and surfaces, like WhatsApp. This is a role for someone who thrives on full end-to-end ownership. You'll set the strategy, bring the ideas, and run the program without waiting to be told what to do. If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are energized by data, automation, and building programs that scale, we'd love to hear from you. Please note: This is a full-time role and qualified candidates must be based in the greater New York City or London area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, while also offering flexibility for employees to choose where they work for the rest of the week.
responsibilities: Own the CRM program end to end - set the strategy and roadmap for every email, push, and SMS, generate the ideas that move it forward, and be the person the company trusts to make the call.
Make AI and automation core - push the program from batch campaigns to an automated, AI-driven Next Best Action model that picks the right message, moment, and channel for each customer.
Lead full-lifecycle messaging - from user onboarding through repeat, winback, and loyalty, with repeat purchase as the core goal.
Explore new channels and surfaces - pilot opportunities like WhatsApp and in-app messaging in partnership with product, and scale the ones that work.
Lead and develop the team - coach the CRM team, prioritize sharply, and raise the bar on both execution and analysis.
Make CRM provably incremental - establish holdout testing and reporting so the program’s revenue impact is measurable.
Partner closely with product and data - work hand in glove to connect CRM messaging with the wider customer experience.

Note: This list represents the highest-priority focus areas for this role. Responsibilities will naturally evolve as the business grows and shifts - candidates should expect the scope to develop over time.
